note: VERIFIED for existence (11.4.270 register scope): the module resolves through the Go module proxy and has a checksum-database record, so IMG-INFRA-CLIENT builds it from source. Fitness caveats are recorded, not hidden: the GitHub project is archived (last push 2025-11-20) and its binary distribution answers 410 Gone, so the client is unmaintained; whether it works against a real S3 service in the WP-13 probes is UNCONFIRMED until the image is built and exercised. No MinIO server image is obtainable (quay.io, docker.io, ghcr.io probed 2026-10-06: unauthorized, denied, 403), so the S3 round trip needs an owner decision on a replacement S3 service (infra-minio is blocked).
